text:
rajesh: Quick rollcall — Integrator bootcamp + SI cert hands-on lab next Tue/Wed. We need: lab GPU slots, exam voucher flow, partner trainer shadow windows, and marketplace listing blurb. Who owns what?

maria: I can take the marketplace blurb + partner-facing checklist. Will draft by EOD Friday. :writing_hand:

devin: Ops note — lab GPU capacity looks tight on Tue afternoon. We can open 10 more slots if we shift non-critical batch jobs to Wed. Need approval from eng-sre.

oliver: edgewave SI here — we need 4 trainer shadow slots (morning sessions). Also asking for 12 exam voucher codes to distribute to cohort. Can those be one-time use?

karen: Partnerships: yes to one-time vouchers. I'll coordinate voucher pool and partner opt-in form. Will add a short consent checkbox for co-marketing.

samir: Training ops — please confirm format: 45m demo + 90m hands-on lab + 30m proctored exam? Also want to reserve 30m Q&A with Redwood product PM.

rajesh: That format works. Samir take lead on schedule and proctoring. Devin/eng-sre: can you confirm the GPU shift and lab autoscaling by EOD Monday?

devin: pinging eng-sre in #eng-sre. If we enable burst pool it will add ~25% cost but should cover the peak. I'll post a config snippet for the job-shift:

```bash
# move non-critical batch to Wed slot
kubectl label node batch-slot=wed backup=true
./schedule-migration --from=tue-afternoon --to=wed-morning --confirm
```

onboard-bot: Reminder: submit trainer shadow roster at least 48h before event. Template: https://redwood.example.com/si-onboard/roster (auto-locks 48h prior).

maria: Drafted blurb, added to the doc: https://redwood.example.com/partners/marketplace-mentions (short blurb + co-branding guidelines). Feedback welcome.

oliver: Confirmed from our side — 4 shadow slots ok, will return list by Monday noon. Voucher request submitted to karen via form. :thumbsup:

karen: Received voucher request. Allocated 12 one-time codes: VCHR-EDGE-001..012. Sending to oliver via secure link. Also adding co-marketing opt-in to partner profile.

samir: Training runbook: added hands-on lab checklist and proctoring steps. Key items: pre-provision accounts, provide sample prompts & eval set, ensure KV-cache reset between runs. Doc link: https://redwood.example.com/training/si-bootcamp-runbook

rajesh: Awesome. Action items summary: maria (marketplace blurb), samir (schedule + runbook), devin (confirm burst pool + job shift), karen (vouchers + opt-in), oliver (trainer roster). Check back here when done.

oliver: Will do — thanks all.

maria: FYI I'll include a short FAQ for partners about Dedicated vs Private deployment options during the lab (common Qs).

devin: Eng-sre approved burst pool at cost estimate +25%. I've scheduled the migration script for Mon 23:00 UTC.

rajesh: Thanks — closing the loop. If anything blocks, escalate in this thread or ping me directly. :rocket:
